source.name: Wikipedia and Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki release catalog
source.notes: Release dates are cross-checked against Wikipedia and the Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki. The release catalog includes MCU titles through Phase Five, The Fantastic Four: First Steps, and the live-action Marvel realities connected through the MCU multiverse: Raimi Spider-Man, Amazing Spider-Man, Sony Spider-Man Universe including the live-action Spider-Noir series and released animated Spider-Verse films and shorts, Fox X-Men, Fantastic Four, Blade, and Daredevil/Elektra. Existing stable IDs are preserved so catalog refreshes do not detach watch progress.
